description: Domain-accuracy benchmark, 30 items across all 13 niches, mix of fact-recall and reasoning. Run in two modes: open-book (relevant KB docs injected) and closed-book (model's own knowledge, no KB). The open−closed gap is the kit's value. must_include = lowercased key points an accurate answer should contain (auto-score; also reviewed by hand).
